{{Otheruses|Fire}}
[[File:AT-AT_MS-1_cannons.png|250px|thumb|Two MS-1 cannons on an AT-AT]]
{{Quote|Target, maximum firepower!|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers]], during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''MS-1 fire-linked heavy laser cannon''' was a powerful [[class II heavy laser cannon]]<ref name="ATATSpecPlate">[["AT-AT" SpecPlate]]</ref> variant employed by [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]. The weapon was mounted in a dual-barrel configuration on the AT-ATs, and could fire in a "one-two punch" pattern or simultaneously; with both of those settings seen in action at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The MS-1 fire-linked heavy laser cannon's firepower could also be altered from the command section by the pilots, ranging from light bolts to a devastating beam that could destroy most ground-based targets at a range of over seventeen [[kilometer]]s.
